extract_action_from_llm_output: extract an AgentAction from LLM output by splitting on a designated token
parse_action_into_parsed_action: parse an AgentAction into a ParsedAction with tool name and arguments
execute_parsed_action_with_logging: execute a ParsedAction and log the result using append_agent_log and make_timestamp
append_final_answer_to_log: append a FinalAnswerLog entry with observation content and attachments to the agent log
create_agent_action_dataclass: create an AgentAction dataclass instance with a rationale string and optional action
